Subject: SKU mapping for channel private offer (CPPO)

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ResellCo is excited to move forward with the CPPO path. Procurement asked for a compact SKU entitlement mapping and the expected invoice owner so they can wire the PO correctly to Marketplace.

Can you confirm the fields you need from our side to finalize the CPPO SKU mapping? At minimum they want:
- ResellCo SKU (internal)
- Redwood SKU (Marketplace listing id)
- Commitment tier (monthly $)
- Billing owner (ResellCo vs buyer entity)

I attached a quick ResellCo draft of the mapping we usually use for other vendors. If you can drop your template back with the Redwood SKUs filled, that’d be ideal. Also please let us know the billing contact for invoicing (and whether Redwood will accept consolidated monthly invoices or per-PO settlement).

Samantha Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, ResellCo

Ava / Monica,

Quick notes after reviewing Samantha's draft and Ava's template:
- Consolidated monthly invoicing: supported for channel private offers, but requires the reseller to include the Marketplace subscription ID and the Reseller entitlements reference on the PO. We will need a billing contact (email) and an AP remit address for the ResellCo entity.
- For accounting, our system needs these columns filled in the CSV: Redwood_Sku, Marketplace_ProductId, Entitlement_ID, Commitment_Tier, Reseller_Sku, Billing_Owner, AP_Email, AP_Remit_Address.
- I attached a small extract (billing-mapping-v1.csv) with the exact header and an example row. Please populate the attached sku-entitlement-draft.xlsx with those headers.

Action owners:
- Samantha: send PO + AP contact + remit address (if different entity)
- Ava: finalize Redwood SKUs in spreadsheet and return to Samantha for PO matching
- Monica: I will create the internal billing ticket and confirm settlement cadence.

If anyone expects tax/VAT complications, flag now (ResellCo is US-based but some buyers route through EU entities).

Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123
